verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own blog post on team comments describes tools that let you @mention teammates and hold internal discussions on an email that external recipients cannot see, which matches the core of this story. However, the quoted text is phrased generically ("the best email collaboration tools") rather than as a documented Superhuman feature spec, so the depth of in-product commenting is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a Superhuman comment side-thread attached to a message, details on how mentions notify teammates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: let you @mention teammates, share live email views, and coordinate responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions
